summary: "The Bag or the Bat" is the pilot episode of the Showtime original series "Ray Donovan", which premiered on June 30, 2013. The episode was directed by Allen Coulter and written by series creator Ann Biderman. Before its television airing, Showtime uploaded it to YouTube, where it was previewed over 150,000 times.
one_line: Pilot episode of Showtime's series "Ray Donovan", premiering June 30, 2013, directed by Allen Coulter and written by Ann Biderman.
key_facts: "The Bag or the Bat" is the pilot episode of the Showtime original series "Ray Donovan".
"The Bag or the Bat" premiered on June 30, 2013.
The series premiere of "Ray Donovan" was directed by Allen Coulter.
The series premiere of "Ray Donovan" was written by series creator Ann Biderman.
Prior to the premiere television airing, "The Bag or the Bat" was uploaded to YouTube by Showtime.
The "The Bag or the Bat" YouTube upload was previewed over 150,000 times before television airing.
